newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala 96-97 sugar exports 781,006 T to June 3.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala 96-97 sugar exports 781,006 T to June 3.

text.p: Guatemala has exported 781,006 tonnes of sugar to June 3 in the 1996-1997 cycle, the Central American Isthmus Sugar Producers said on Tuesday in an update.

The export report covers the period of Guatemala's current 1996-1997 sugar harvest from November 1. Sugar exports for the same period of the previous harvest, from Nov. 1, 1995 through June 4, 1996, totalled 765,112 tonnes.
Exports for the current harvest so far were two percent higher than exports for the previous harvest over the same period, the producers' group said.
Of the total amount exported to date, refined and white sugar exports were 245,647 tonnes and raws were 535,359 tonnes.

According to the report, the United States was the major destination of Guatemalan sugar exports. Under the quota system, 59,036 tonnes of raw sugar and 1,450 tonnes of bulk white sugar have been exported to the United States.
Guatemala imported and re-exported an additional 148,183 tonnes of raw sugar and 17,400 tonnes of bulk white sugar to the United States, it added.

Other destinations include 108,990 to Morocco (all raws), 98,900 tonnes to Chile (all refined), 75,250 to Canada (all raws), 71,700 to Sri Lanka (14,000 raws, 57,700 refined and white), 53,400 to Africa (39,400 raw, 14,000 white), and 36,000 to Mexico (all raws).
Smaller amounts were also exported to Haiti, Jamaica, Peru, Lithuania and Yemen.
